item: Row 422 P6: the per-item counter sweep is left to the deferred drain
key_paths: src/backup/merge.py; src/backup/volume_job.py; src/api/backup_v2.py; src/api/boot_sequence.py; src/api/main.py; src/api/insights.py; src/analytics/queries.py; src/analytics/engine_report.py; src/briefing/card_audit.py; src/ai_layer/triage_proposal.py; src/analytics/store.py; src/static/app-corpus.js; src/static/app-insights.js; tests/test_counter_sweep_left_to_drain.py
summary: A committing import whose re-index is deferred no longer runs the whole-corpus counter sweep per item (capped at 30 s and incomplete anyway); it opens and commits the R22 deferral marker first, so the counters read estimated until the drain's closing sweep reconciles them in full. The hand-off starts the drain for the sweep even with nothing pending, and a start after a kill finds the open marker and starts it. Bench (122k into a 5.5 GB encrypted store): 213.4 s to 185.7 s.
